data_fields.name: plunder_pause
data_fields.donor_constant: 120 (pilotError; comment says two seconds; unit not read)

best_idea: A bank or bag move takes what fits and returns the rest to the source, and a takeoff-style distribution hands a pool back to the carriers in a fixed priority order, so nothing is lost when space runs out.
decision_why: Take-what-fits moves, the remainder kept in the source, the uncapped pool and a fixed priority order fit one ledger; the per-ship holds conflict with one character, one ledger, so they are not copied.
acceptance: A server test asserts that moving 50 units into a bag with room for 10 moves 10, leaves 40 in the bank ledger and keeps the total at 50; that a takeoff-style distribution fills the flagship view by preference before escorts; and that a loot take of 5 into 3 free slots records 3 taken and 2 left in one write; on a 375 px phone the loot card reads 'took 3 of 5, 2 stay'.
